summary: Franco-Nevada filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders held May 12. All nine director nominees were elected with overwhelming support (95.91%-99.79%), PricewaterhouseCoopers was reappointed as auditor (98.32% for), and the say-on-pay advisory resolution passed (91.33% for). No forced management changes, acquisition, or special-situation event occurred. This is a routine meeting outcome disclosure, not a special situation.
